author: Alexander Newby
title: Let's Roll Press is looking for Artists
content: Let's Roll Press is looking for Artists. About Let's Roll Press: We're the people behind Chapelwick, the cosmic horror campaign that launched on Kickstarter last year. We're expanding our art team to accelerate development. The Role: We're looking for a few talented artists to create professional illustrations for our Campaign Setting. New illustration batches are commissioned as each batch is completed. What We're Looking For: Strong portfolio demonstrating TTRPG or fantasy illustration experience; Ability to work from detailed creative briefs, maintain visual consistency across series, and accommodate art direction and revisions; Proficiency with digital art tools; Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality; Professional communication and reliable delivery; Bonus: Experience with both 2D and 3D workflows; Bonus: Familiarity with Elden Ring, Bloodborne, Dark Souls, etc. Terms: Independent contractor basis (1099); $275–$650+ per illustration; Commissions paid via PayPal only; Ongoing collaboration opportunities. To apply: https://forms.cloud.microsoft.com/r/3jtz31vMRz
